g.text: Editing is on the table, one cell at a time: ⏎ on a value, + and -, space on a
A per-channel edit writes the whole setup dump: the unit “receive[s] and
understand[s] the old setup dump” (spec p. 29), so p2ked reads the live dump,
changes the one field and sends the dump back. The write gate applies and the
field is read back to verify it -- every other byte is the one the unit just
sent (tests/test_messages.py's TestSetupDumpEncoder). No parameter ID is
invented: this writes the dump's own field positions. The first unit contact
is `make test-hardware`'s unmodified-dump round trip, and until it has run no
unit has received one. The ID-based alternative still needs docs/TODO item
